config_schema.reason: Exact schema key identities are required by frozen content readers. Their values are still scanned.
config_schema.use: Authenticated file content only; never used as a wrapper name, path, argument, environment entry or log line.

input_identity.reason: Original identity text preserves authenticated config content. The consumer uses the separately checked opaque pin_paths value, never this identity as its job path.
input_identity.use: Authenticated file content only; never used as a wrapper name, path, argument, environment entry or log line.

refusal_vocabulary.reason: The exact bound WORDS values are required to recognize and suppress forbidden names, not to emit them.
refusal_vocabulary.use: Authenticated file content only; never used as a wrapper name, path, argument, environment entry or log line.

room_rule.reason: The exact human-readable admission annotation preserves the pinned card content; it does not control a job name or output.
room_rule.use: Authenticated file content only; never used as a wrapper name, path, argument, environment entry or log line.

source_inventory.reason: Source identity keys must match the frozen tree and producer inventory seals; they are integrity declarations inside file content.
source_inventory.use: Authenticated file content only; never used as a wrapper name, path, argument, environment entry or log line.

staging_schema.reason: The frozen staging reader requires this exact schema key (which contains sti). Its path value is always scanned.
staging_schema.use: Authenticated file content only; never used as a wrapper name, path, argument, environment entry or log line.
